alerts.message: All lifts between platforms 0-8 and the footbridge are currently out of order at London Kings Cross station.
Hot weather is disrupting some Gatwick Express, Great Northern, Southern and Thameslink routes. More details and a full impact can be found in  Status and Disruptions .

From Monday 15 June until mid-September, step free access will be unavailable for the Thameslink platforms, A and B, as the lifts will be closed for major refurbishment works at London St Pancras International station.
The accessible toilets on platform B are out of order at London St Pancras International station.

Major disruption between London St Pancras International and Bedford. You should only travel if your journey is essential. There is no train service between Luton and Bedford and you will have to use rail replacement transport between these stations. Latest information and the impact on your journey can be found in  Status and Disruptions.
Hot weather is disrupting some Gatwick Express, Great Northern, Southern and Thameslink routes. More details and a full impact can be found in  Status and Disruptions .

The escalators are out of order between the lawn mezzanine level and the ground floor, and the descending escalators are out of order between the London Underground platforms and the main concourse at London Paddington station.

An amended service is in place between Didcot Parkway / Newbury and London Paddington. GWR Main Line trains will not call at Twyford, Maidenhead and Slough. Latest information can be found in  Status and Disruptions .
Trains running between London Paddington and Heathrow Terminals / Reading may be cancelled, delayed by up to 25 minutes or revised. Latest information can be found in  Status and Disruptions.
An amended South Western Railway timetable is in place from Tuesday 23 to Thursday 25 June due to the hot weather. More information can be found in  Status & Disruptions .
Hot weather is disrupting some Gatwick Express, Great Northern, Southern and Thameslink routes. More details and a full impact can be found in  Status and Disruptions .
Trains between Lewes and Eastbourne may be cancelled, delayed or revised. More details can be found in  Status and Disruptions.

correlations.headline: Lyon Part-Dieu delays are raising SNCF network alert count
correlations.explanation: The Lyon Part-Dieu board is showing delayed departures while SNCF incidents are already active, so the wall treats Lyon as a likely contributor to the national alert picture.
correlations.cause: Delayed departures at Lyon Part-Dieu alongside active SNCF incidents
correlations.effect: 15 SNCF alerts are being reinforced by disruption around Lyon

correlations.headline: TfL line issues may affect London Eurostar access
correlations.explanation: Disrupted Tube or Elizabeth line services in London can make it harder to reach St Pancras and the wider Eurostar access corridor.
correlations.effect: Passengers heading to or from Eurostar may need longer access and egress times in London

correlations.headline: UK mainline delays may weaken onward movement from Eurostar arrivals
correlations.explanation: National Rail delays across the monitored London terminals raise the risk that arriving Eurostar passengers will face slower onward domestic connections.
correlations.effect: London arrivals from Eurostar may see a less reliable handoff into UK rail
